name: Murtaza
mythology: Greek (unofficial easter egg entry, not part of the real site content)
summary: A mortal hero of legendary stubbornness who undertakes a series of increasingly ridiculous trials. The greatest of these is building an entire mythology encyclopedia from scratch. Not divine, but occasionally mistaken for it after a good deploy.
domain_role: Persistence, sarcasm, unreasonable amounts of late-night productivity
origin_story: Unlike Hercules, no god fathered this hero. He was an ordinary mortal who decided, at 2am and fueled by coffee and stubbornness, to build a mythology encyclopedia website from nothing. What followed was a series of trials no less grueling than the Twelve Labors, if considerably lower stakes.
achievements: Fought valiantly against the evil forces of Harsh Mysteriousness (also known as: cryptic error messages with no line numbers)
Vanquished the Redeemer of Bad WiFi mid-deployment
Successfully argued with an AI assistant about nav bar padding and won
Built an entire encyclopedia of twelve Olympians before finishing the coffee that started it
Survived several rounds of academic combat against formidable rivals (see below) and lived to tell the tale

signature_quote.note: Disputed attribution. Some scholars believe this phrase predates recorded history.
